request.style: English, heartfelt country, warm male vocal with gentle twang, acoustic guitar, pedal steel, fiddle, brushed drums, honest storytelling, 84 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Peter asked the Teacher on a dusty afternoon
How many times must I forgive my brother, is seven times enough
Jesus looked him in the eye and gave a gentle smile
Not seven times, my friend, but seventy-seven times

[Chorus]
Seventy-seven times and then a little more
Leave the light on in the window, keep a key beneath the door
'Cause the grace I've been given is the grace I'm meant to give
Seventy-seven times, that's the way I want to live

[Verse]
There's a boy who took his money and he ran off to the town
Spent it all on easy living till the money ran out
He came walking home in rags, rehearsing what he'd say
But his father saw him coming from a long, long way

[Chorus]
Seventy-seven times and then a little more
Leave the light on in the window, keep a key beneath the door
'Cause the grace I've been given is the grace I'm meant to give
Seventy-seven times, that's the way I want to live

[Bridge]
He ran to him and held him tight
Threw a party on that night
He was lost and now he's found
He was dead and he's alive

[Outro]
Seventy-seven times
That's the way I want to live
